about: What the default plan held after each close in the point-in-time backtest (research/backtest/refresh.sh), as shares of stocks, gold, bonds, cash and managed futures; a row stays in force until the next one. The market events page reads it, with the paper record (data/paper_ledger.json) after its end. prices: the daily closes of SPY and the gold and bond lines the backtest used, for the scanner page's "Where the plan was" chart.
